result.title: How Audi is Reimagining Production With Digital Twins and Physical AI
result.description:
Audi teams are reimaginging production with digital twins and physical AI. See how production teams will build digital twins in DELMIA using LEO, a Dassault Systemes’ virtual companion and foundational knowledge from the 3DEXPERIENCE platform. With NVIDIA Omniverse libraries enabling perception and motion simulation, these digital twins become the virtual training ground for mobile humanoid robots from Agile Robots and Idealworks.

Scaling the simulation to multi-robot fleets ensures safe operation and will save months in future testing of logistics processes.

result.title: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots to Walk in Simulation #NVIDIAGTC #Microducks #Robotics
result.description:
🦆 Put AI agents to work to help your robot learn to navigate.

Using Microduck as the reference robot, this walkthrough shows how to create a simulated obstacle course with OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, build 3D assets with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries, simulate physics with Newton, train policies in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, and validate them in Isaac Sim on NVIDIA RTX Spark.
